subject: SDK quickstart & auth plan for Novus Health integration
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@novushealth.io>, Priya Shah <priya@novushealth.io>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: SDK quickstart & auth plan for Novus Health integration

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end so we can keep momentum on the pilot: 

What we covered
- Goal: embed low-latency clinical note summarization in the Novus EMR workflow (initial scope: discharge summaries, pilot 2–3 clinics).
- Recommended runtime: Redwood hosted to start (fastest onboarding), then Dedicated when stable.
- Auth model: short-term — API keys + VPC peering for secure traffic. Medium-term — OIDC with SAML SSO (your IdP) and scoped tokens.
- Integration points: client-side SDK (Python) for backend services; TypeScript sample for front-end preview pipeline; embeddings for semantic search/reranking on patient notes.

Immediate asks / proposed owners
1) SDK quickstart: we will share a minimal Python sample and a TS preview app. Owner: Aditya (internal). Target: EOD Thu (2026-09-16).
2) Auth decision: confirm whether Novus prefers SAML SSO (enterprise) or classic API keys for pilot. Owner: Novus. ETA: EOD Wed (2026-09-15).
3) Data flow and routing: brief diagram + preferred region. Owner: Novus + Rishi to align on routing policies.
4) Security artifacts: SOC2 summary + data retention options. We’ll attach the checklist and MAP.

Attachments: novus_sdk_checklist.pdf (integration tasks + env checklist), novus_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (calendar-style timeline).

Next sync: 30-min technical call Thursday 09:00 PT if that works — please confirm.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir@novushealth.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@novushealth.io>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK quickstart & auth plan for Novus Health integration

Lauren —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers from our side: 
- Pilot auth: we want to start with API keys scoped to a service account for the pilot (easier for our Ops). We intend to move to SAML SSO for production.
- Region: us-west-2 preferred (closest to our main infra).
- Security docs: SOC2 is great — please also include any details on KMS integration and audit logs (we'll need them for procurement).

Can Aditya drop the Python quickstart into a repo we can clone? Also, a one-page diagram of the data flow (what stays in Novus vs what goes to Redwood) would help procurement.

Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Engineering 
Novus Health

Samir / Priya —

I'll put together a small repo (MIT-licensed sample) that contains: 
- Python quickstart (Flask example) showing: API key usage, simple prompt wrapper, streaming responses, and local dev instructions.
- TypeScript example (Next.js preview) that calls a backend endpoint for structured tool-calling responses.
- Embeddings snippet: how to index patient note vectors, rerank examples with a small candidate set, and memory considerations for pii.

Notes on auth & routing:
- Pilot: API keys with role-scoped tokens + IP allowlist. We'll provide instructions to rotate keys using your existing KMS (examples for AWS KMS).
- SSO transition: we support OIDC with SAML IdP mapping; Rishi will prepare the SSO mapping doc and required claims.
- Routing: you can set a policy that routes high-priority records to Dedicated trackers (when we onboard). For now, all traffic to hosted in us-west-2.

I'll create the repo under a short-lived org link and share the Drive diagram. ETA: Thu 2026-09-16 17:00 PT.

Attachment: (none in this note)

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Samir / Priya —

Thanks — this is perfect. Quick logistics: 
- Confirmed: Thu 09:00 PT technical sync (30 min). Invite sent.
- Deliverables attached: novus_sdk_checklist.pdf (detailed environment checklist) and novus_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (timeline + owners).

Short pre-read for the call:
- Python quickstart will include: virtualenv steps, how to set REDWOOD_API_KEY locally, example prompt templates for clinical summarization, and a pytest-based local test harness that stubs responses for offline dev.
- TS preview: fetch preview token via backend, demonstrate function/tool-calling style structured outputs (JSON schema enforcement) and a small demo reranker using cosine similarity on embeddings.
- Security: we will provide an appendix with audit log query examples and sample KMS key policy.

Action items before the call (owners & due dates)
- Novus: confirm pilot API key rotation window and point-of-contact for procurement (Samir) — due Wed EOD.
- Redwood: share repo links + diagrams (Aditya) — due Thu EOD.
- Rishi: draft SSO claim mapping doc for later (Rishi) — due next Tue.

If anything changes to the attendees or timeline, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the sync.

Regards,
Lauren
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
